framings.text: I think this is about giving the next person a low-friction, PR-thread view of what Tinkery checks established: real-model evidence, stub mechanics, and the operator's own recognition, while preventing unuseful questions from recurring.

outcome: Before dogfooding, the next person can quickly understand in the PR thread what was actually checked, distinguish real-model evidence from stub mechanics and the operator's own recognition, and avoid questions already judged unuseful.

alternatives.label: Conditional candidate: add a compact receipt to the PR thread after relevant checks
alternatives.benefit: Makes evidence and check status visible with little manual entry, if the needed details are available.
alternatives.cost: A compact receipt may omit context or become stale when checks are partial or changed.
alternatives.undo_cost: Provisional: correcting or removing posted receipts may require follow-up clarification.

alternatives.label: Conditional candidate: reuse links to existing check evidence and update a lightweight PR-thread summary
alternatives.benefit: Avoids creating another receipt format while keeping relevant evidence discoverable and reducing repetitive entry.
alternatives.cost: Information may be fragmented, and the summary may depend on people keeping links current.
alternatives.undo_cost: Provisional: returning to the current scattered-link workflow may leave context distributed across prior updates.
